choices: Call `some_child->SetVisible(false)` instead of removing it
`AddChildView(std::make_unique<...>())`, then `RemoveChildView(child)` followed by `delete child;`
`AddChildView(std::make_unique<...>())`; remove via `parent->RemoveChildViewT(some_child)`

explain: Use the `unique_ptr` overload of `AddChildView()`, and `RemoveChildViewT()` to remove-and-destroy: it returns a `unique_ptr`, making ownership explicit. Plain `RemoveChildView()` does not delete.

choices: Move the `RemoveObserver` call into `Shutdown()` instead of the destructor

Keep the destructor call but remove the one in `OnTabStripModelDestroyed`

choices: Keep `static_cast` but add `DCHECK(some_view->GetClassName() == ...)`
`reinterpret_cast<MyCustomView*>(some_view)` with a null check
`views::AsViewClass<MyCustomView>(some_view)` + null check

explain: RTTI is disabled, so `dynamic_cast` isn't available. `views::AsViewClass`/`IsViewClass` walk the `METADATA_HEADER` chain and return `nullptr` on mismatch (even for partially constructed views); `static_cast` gives UB.

prompt:
A teammate adds a new bubble:

```cpp
class MyBubble : public views::BubbleDialogDelegateView { ... };
```

What should they do instead?
choices: Build a `ui::DialogModel` and show it via `BubbleDialogModelHost`
Inherit from `views::WidgetDelegateView` and draw a bubble border
Inherit from `views::DialogDelegateView` instead
Keep it, but move business logic into a separate helper class
explain: `BubbleDialogDelegateView` is deprecated: merging delegate and view muddles ownership. Use a `ui::DialogModel` + `BubbleDialogModelHost` factory; the widget takes the host via `release()`.

prompt: You need a non-bubble modal dialog with OK/Cancel. Which approach follows Brave's standard?
choices: Subclass `views::DialogDelegate` and `SetContentsView()` a separate View
Subclass `views::View` and show it in a plain `views::Widget`
Subclass `views::DialogDelegateView` and lay out children directly in it
Subclass `views::BubbleDialogDelegateView` with no anchor view
explain: `DialogDelegateView` is deprecated. Inherit `DialogDelegate` alone, give it a separate contents `View`, and show it with `DialogDelegate::CreateDialogWidget()`.

choices: Only Tor is affected; add an `IsTor()` check and keep fetching for Incognito
No problem — favicons are public resources, so nothing leaks
Set a Tor proxy on the `ImageFetcher` so requests are routed correctly
It uses the system network context; skip if `profile_->IsOffTheRecord()`
explain: `ImageFetcherService` isn't profile-bound: off-the-record requests leave the profile's network partition and Tor requests bypass the proxy. Skip for OTR profiles and fall back to a default; use a `SimpleURLLoader` with the profile's `URLLoaderFactory` if needed.

choices: `if (profile->IsTor()) writer.MarkAsOffTheRecord();` — Incognito is fine
`if (profile->IsOffTheRecord()) writer.MarkAsOffTheRecord();`
Clear the clipboard when the private window closes

explain: `MarkAsOffTheRecord()` keeps private content out of OS clipboard history and cloud sync. Tor profiles are off-the-record, so `IsOffTheRecord()` alone covers them.
